submission.justification: Module-D2 gives the highest light yield (54.9 PE/MeV at 30%), but it fails the robustness requirement: 30% of modules failed after 20 thermal cycles (300 K to 87 K), against a limit of 5%, due to light-guide bonding cracks. Since modules cannot be accessed after fill, D2 is rejected. Module-D1 gives 36.1 PE/MeV at 30% coverage, the highest light yield among the robust designs (D3 gives 23.9 PE/MeV at 30%), with a 2% thermal-cycling failure rate that meets the 5% limit. 30% is the maximum allowed coverage, and the meeting notes confirm enough feedthroughs exist for 30% coverage. Cold electronics are validated for D1.
